svg.title: What to record about your model setup
svg.desc: Three related areas to document: requests, model configuration, and hosting and hardware. These are aspects of the setup, not sequential steps.
svg.text: What to record about your model setup
Three related aspects to document, rather than a sequence of steps.
Messages, roles, instructions, and conversation history
The client or chat product used; API and endpoint, where applicable
Model and version; tokenizer and chat template, where available
Response settings, including request parameters and server defaults
Provider service or model-serving software and version
Hosting location and CPU/GPU details, where available
Record what you can access and note what the provider does not disclose.
These details support reproducibility alongside the experimental procedure and data.
